name: markettech-kitchen-store
description: MarketTech Kitchen storefront with Cloudflare Pages Functions, D1 and R2

scripts.check: node --check public/app.js && node --check public/admin.js && node --check "functions/api/[[path]].js" && node --check "functions/uploads/[[path]].js" && node --check public/applications/core.js && node --check public/applications/stage.js && node --check public/applications/tool.js && node --check public/applications/applications.js && for f in public/applications/tools/*.js; do node --check $f; done
scripts.test: npm run test:import && npm run test:storefront && npm run test:applications
